meta.name: alfworld-object-disposer
meta.description: This skill disposes of an object by placing it into a disposal receptacle like a garbage can. It should be triggered when the task requires discarding an object (e.g., 'put it in garbagecan') and the agent is at the disposal location with the object in hand. The skill executes the 'put' action to place the object in/on the target receptacle, completing the disposal subtask.

copy.tagline: 把手中物品丢进垃圾桶
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中执行丢弃物品的任务。
copy.tagline_en: Dispose of an object into a garbage can
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discard objects in a virtual environment.

howto.what: 装上后，当你吩咐Claude丢弃一个物体（比如“把它扔进垃圾桶”）时，如果它手上拿着该物体并已站在垃圾桶旁，就会执行“put”动作，把物体放进垃圾桶，完成丢弃任务。
howto.when: 当你的指令明确要求丢弃某个物体（例如“put it in garbagecan”），且Claude已手持该物体、位于丢弃容器（如垃圾桶）附近时触发。

say.text: 把这个苹果扔进垃圾桶。

say.note: 如果Claude手上拿着书，会自动put到附近的垃圾桶。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can dispose of an object it is holding by placing it into a disposal receptacle (e.g., garbage can) using the 'put' action, completing a discard subtask.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task requires discarding an object (e.g., 'put it in garbagecan') and Claude is holding the object and located near the disposal receptacle.

say_en.text: Put this apple in the trash can.
Throw away the book you are holding.
say_en.note: If Claude is holding the book, it will put it into the nearest garbage can.
